ideas.pitch: Satellite-based remote sensing platform for monitoring regional agricultural land compliance, yield forecasting, and soil health anomalies using multi-spectral indices.
ideas.title: AgriCrop-Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agriculture & Sustainability domain while employing heavy geospatial data processing, mimicking winning architecture from regional compliance hackathons.

ideas.pitch: Explainable patient health deterioration warning system combining graph intelligence and gradient boosting to flag critical vitals and early sepsis risks in hospital settings.
ideas.title: MediGraph-Risk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Healthcare & Wellness domain and leverages advanced graph-based risk modeling inspired by award-winning financial and clinical monitoring architectures.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student advisory platform using RAG and LangGraph to generate personalized academic roadmaps, career paths, and real-time tutoring interventions for technical institutes.
ideas.title: EduAgent-Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the EdTech domain and utilizes multi-agent orchestration proven to win developer competitions by providing functional, deeply customized student workflows.

ideas.pitch: Dynamic route optimization and predictive congestion management system for smart city transit authorities leveraging real-time telemetry and spatial forecasting.
ideas.title: SmartTransit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Travel & Smart Cities domain with production-ready forecasting algorithms and robust visualization tailored for municipal judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered personalized nutrition and dietary restriction management assistant that generates local meal plans and tracks micro-nutrients using computer vision for food logging.
ideas.title: NutriPlan-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical consumer utility in the Healthcare & Wellness domain with rapid-to-implement vision APIs, following previous rapid-hackathon winning formats.
